exercises.prompt: The survey found a relationship, not proof of cause. Choose the accurate claim.
exercises.context: Students who used flexible schedules also reported higher satisfaction.

options.text: Flexible schedules were associated with higher satisfaction.

exercises.explanationVi: “Was associated with” mô tả mối liên hệ mà không khẳng định quan hệ nhân quả chưa được chứng minh.
exercises.additionalExample: Regular attendance was associated with stronger course completion.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: Careful claim strength supports accurate interpretation in Reading and Writing.

authoring.construct: Distinguish association language from an unsupported causal claim.
authoring.observableBehavior: Selects the association phrase when evidence only reports co-occurrence.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: Was associated with states a relationship without asserting that one variable caused the other.

distractorRationales.rationale: Caused is stronger than the survey evidence permits.
Prevented reverses the direction and invents causation.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: Khảo sát quan sát được mối liên hệ nhưng không kiểm soát nguyên nhân. Vì vậy dùng “was associated with”, không dùng “caused”.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original synthetic survey context; wording reflects standard research-claim distinctions, not an external empirical claim.

exercises.prompt: Select both claims that do not present causation as proven.
exercises.context: The survey found that flexible access and higher satisfaction occurred together. It did not test causation.

options.text: Flexible access may contribute to higher satisfaction.
Higher satisfaction was associated with flexible access.
Flexible access was the only cause of higher satisfaction.

exercises.explanationVi: A chỉ nêu khả năng và C chỉ nêu mối liên hệ; “guarantees” và “the only cause” trình bày nhân quả như điều đã chắc chắn.
exercises.additionalExample: Access to support may contribute to persistence, but other factors may also matter.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: Selecting cautious causal language supports precise academic argumentation.

authoring.construct: Recognise two evidence-aligned cause/effect formulations among absolute overclaims.
authoring.observableBehavior: Selects both cautious options and no absolute option.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: May contribute to marks uncertainty, while was associated with makes no causal assertion.

distractorRationales.rationale: Guarantees asserts certainty unsupported by an observational survey.
The only cause excludes alternatives without evidence.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: Ngôn ngữ học thuật cần phản ánh đúng lực của bằng chứng. “May contribute to” là khả năng; “was associated with” chỉ mối liên hệ; hai lựa chọn còn lại là tuyệt đối hóa.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original synthetic survey context; no external empirical claim.

exercises.prompt: Rewrite the claim so it reports association rather than proven cause.
exercises.context: Online study led to higher grades.

hint.copyVi: Dữ liệu chỉ cho thấy hai yếu tố xuất hiện cùng nhau; dùng cụm “was associated with”.

acceptedAnswers: Online study was associated with higher grades.

exercises.explanationVi: “Led to” khẳng định nguyên nhân; “was associated with” chỉ báo mối liên hệ phù hợp dữ liệu.
exercises.additionalExample: Library use was associated with higher course completion.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: This avoids overstating evidence when paraphrasing a source.

authoring.construct: Replace an unsupported causal verb with an association collocation.
authoring.observableBehavior: Produces the declared cautious sentence after a targeted hint.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: Was associated with accurately reports a relationship without claiming causal proof.

distractorRationales.response: Online study led to higher grades.
distractorRationales.rationale: Led to still presents cause as established.

distractorRationales.response: Higher grades led to online study.
distractorRationales.rationale: The rewrite reverses the direction but remains an unsupported causal claim.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: Khi nguồn chỉ nêu tương quan, hãy dùng cụm trung tính như “be associated with”. Không đổi hướng nhân quả để né lỗi; cần giảm lực của chính tuyên bố.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original synthetic sentence created for this project.

exercises.prompt: Use the two-word phrase meaning ‘be one factor in’: Flexibility may ___ higher satisfaction.
exercises.explanationVi: Cụm “may contribute to” nêu một yếu tố có thể góp phần mà không coi đó là nguyên nhân duy nhất.
exercises.additionalExample: Regular feedback may contribute to learner confidence.
exercises.ieltsRelevance: Cause/effect collocations with hedging support precise Task 2 claims.

authoring.construct: Produce the cause/effect collocation contribute to under a cautious modal.
authoring.observableBehavior: Types the exact collocation that completes the evidence-aligned claim.
authoring.correctAnswerRationale: Contribute to collocates with the noun phrase and allows other factors to remain possible.

distractorRationales.rationale: Cause is one word and does not match the supplied meaning ‘be one factor in’.
Result requires result in, while the prompt already supplies no preposition after the blank.

authoring.detailedExplanationVi: “Contribute to + noun” nghĩa là góp phần tạo nên kết quả. Kết hợp với “may”, câu giữ đúng mức thận trọng và không loại trừ các yếu tố khác.
authoring.sourceBasis: Original project-authored collocation task based on standard academic English usage.
